$description: Source of truth for @kairos-io/design, in the W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format: a token is an object with $value and $type, a group holds tokens, and a {path.to.token} value is an alias. scripts/build.cjs resolves it into tokens.css, tailwind.css and src/tokens/resolved.json; scripts/check.cjs fails when a deck and this file disagree. Edit this file, then run `npm run build`. The theme names are the ones the decks use as var(--ink), var(--sub), var(--accent-soft).

base.$description: The one literal every brand shares.

brand.$description: From the logos. They do not change with the theme.

kairos-light.$description: The top rhombus of the mark.

hadron-blue.$description: Hadron blue. White text on it.

tile.$description: The tiles' status tones, for a loader that has succeeded or failed: three steps each, the deepest the status colour itself, like the three oranges of the mark. They do not change with the theme.

success-light.$description: The top rhombus of a green cube.

success-mid.$description: The left rhombus; the dark theme's ok.

success-deep.$description: The right rhombus: the healthy green.

error-light.$description: The top rhombus of a red cube.

error-deep.$description: The right rhombus: the recovery red.

status.$description: Node-state colours and the ink that sits on them. The same in both themes.

warning.$description: The console's warning amber: the CPU diamond, build warning text.

ink.$description: Text on a status fill, such as the destructive button.

themes.$description: The semantic colours, one value per theme. Light is the default; dark follows data-theme="dark" or the system setting.

on-accent.$description: Text on the accent: dark ink on Kairos orange
Dark ink on the soft orange too

variants.$description: A few screens change a few values. Set data-variant="<name>" on the element that carries data-theme, or below it. Each variant lists only the names it changes, per theme.

console.$description: Console screens (Nodes, Node Detail, Build Artifact): a lighter hairline in the light theme. Nodes also uses the dark orange for accent-soft in the light theme.

site.$description: kairos.io and hadron-linux.io homepages: a darker raised surface in the dark theme.

hadron.$description: hadron-linux.io: Hadron blue accent, white text on it, and the Hadron link colors. accent-line, accent-soft and code-key are not set here, so they stay Kairos orange; no deck defines Hadron values for them.

installer.$description: Kairos Installer: a darker code bar in the dark theme.

foundations.$description: Foundations deck: a lighter hairline in the dark theme.

size.$description: The type scale: size, weight and tracking per step, line height where the deck sets one.

min-size.$description: Text is never smaller than this; the render check fails a page that is.

space.$description: The spacing scale. Tailwind's step is 4px, so p-4 is 16px.

radius.$description: 2 for tags, 4 by default, 8 for dialogs.

scale.$description: Multiplies every duration. --duration-scale on <html> retimes the whole system at once, for reviewing motion slowly; 0 stops it. prefers-reduced-motion still wins.

rules.textOnAccent: ink on Kairos orange, white on Hadron blue

untokenised.$description: Hex colors the decks use that are not a clear token yet. The check accepts them so a new hex still fails. They are not written to the CSS. Move one into a token when the maintainers decide what it is.

colors.#C94300: Talk Deck: darkest tile of the orange gradient
colors.#F26A2A: Talk Deck: tile outline in the gradient
colors.#7A2800: Talk Deck: dark orange text or fill
colors.#8B889A: Installer: comment color in the cloud-config sample
colors.#6A6879: Installer: muted text in the code sample
colors.#E04848: Node Detail: red, not the recovery red
colors.#EEEDF2: Foundations and Talk Deck: table row hairline
